# Auto-generated content

The majority of these files should not be edited directly as they're automatically generated by Terraform. Instead, update the terraform template files within the `k8s-tf/templates` directory.

The current list of files that are not generated dynamically via templates (and therefore can be edited directly are):

* [rbac.yaml](./addons/kasten-io/rbac.yaml)
* [volume-snapshot-class.yaml](./addons/kasten-io/volume-snapshot-class.yaml)
